messages:
deploy-bot: kickoff: rolling deploy v2.3.1 -> regions [US, EU, APAC]. stage order = US -> EU -> APAC. change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. canaries enabled. pin=stable-v2.3.1 :rocket:
release-engineer: quick heads-up — release notes uploaded to /releases/v2.3.1.md, highlights: batching perf + kv-cache fix + quantization fallback. link: https://internal/release/v2.3.1
erin: adv-check: US warm pool = 60 GPUs available, expected throughput +18% with new kernels. no infra alerts in last 24h.
ops-oncall: confirmed US quotas: reserved slots 48, spare 12. warmup script queued. monitoring hooks set.
raj: EU capacity check: node pool A at 85% baseline, free GPUs 8. if traffic spike >25% we may hit soft throttle.
linda: APAC: maintenance window overlaps with target. some hosts rebooting at 03:30 UTC. suggest postpone APAC stage.
sam: canary results (US): 2000 requests, p95 latency -5ms, error rate stable at 0.2%. logs look clean. rolling canary -> proceed if no objections.
miguel: quick note — we observed kv-cache warmup staleness in canary for long prefixes, need to watch prefix-hit metric. mitigation: shorten canary request length or enable prewarm.
release-engineer: decision needed: proceed US now, gate EU until capacity bump, hold APAC to next window? propose yes to US, pause after US for 30m to re-evaluate EU.
erin: +1 to that. also toggle quant-fallback policy to allow 8-bit fallback for EU if we see rate-limited errors. add to rollout commands: `--allow-quant-fallback`
ops-oncall: implementing EU quota uplift request now (support ticket #4572). ETA ~25m. will post when applied.
raj: if uplift doesn't land, recommend pin EU to previous runtime (stable-v2.2.9) rather than risk throttles. we can simulate expected load with k6 quick sweep.
sam: agree. set rollback trigger: sustained error >1% for 5m OR p95 > 450ms for 3m. auto-rollback enabled on those signals.
miguel: add a manual rollback checklist to thread: include steps to pin version, revoke traffic, and clear kv-cache.
release-engineer: noted. I pushed a canary playbook snippet: ```
# apply canary to region
deployctl canary --region us --version v2.3.1 --duration 15m --metrics p95,err
```
deploy-bot: US canary started @3104501215. tracking metrics in #metrics-stream. will post updates. :eyes:
ops-oncall: EU uplift applied @3104501450 — 16 GPUs added to pool A. still monitoring thermals.
raj: re-checking quick sim now, k6 sample looks within safe margins. if we get 10%+ burst we still degrade but within auto-fallback thresholds.
erin: proceeding with US rollout slice 1 -> slice 2, will pause after slice 2 for 30m. tagging @release-engineer for final go/no-go.
release-engineer: go for US slices. EU pause until uplift validated. APAC deferred to next change window. logging decision in release notes. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollout started US slice 1 @3104501510. progress updates will follow.
sam: monitoring dashboards green. p95 steady. continuing to watch kv prefix-hit.
miguel: tracking prefix-hit; enabling prewarm on a small subset to reduce first-token spikes.
ops-oncall: note: if EU errors cross threshold, we'll pin EU back to stable-v2.2.9 and open rollback ticket.
release-engineer: final: US proceed, EU conditional on uplift verification, APAC moved. leaving thread open for 1h for post-rollout checks. :thumbsup:
__notes: Generated Slack thread for region-by-region rollout coordination with capacity checks and rollback criteria.
